info.title: BuilderAd private web application API
info.description: Same-origin web contracts. Laravel identity, session, grants, WorkspaceContext and RLS retain authority. Not a native authentication contract.

200.description: Authorized canonical projection. Never shared-cache private data.

X-Builderad-Identity.description: Server document evidence, verified by the web transport. Not independent authority.

401.description: No current authenticated session. A stale document may instead be rejected with identityConflict 409 before auth.

403.description: Unverified principal, absent Workspace scope or withdrawn grant. No write effect.

409.description: CAS mismatch: preserve draft and explicitly review current version. identityConflict=true instead closes the document; never adopt it as a CAS conflict.

419.description: CSRF rejection, including a transport session that no longer contains the CSRF token. No write effect.

422.description: Invalid exact JSON value/version shape, size or domain selection; errors.value contains validation messages.

get.description: Accept application/json for canonical preferences. Native HTML requests receive the unified SPA shell, without a business projection.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
parameters.description: Browser CSRF token. Laravel 13 may accept trusted same-origin Fetch Metadata before token validation; absent that evidence a valid token is required.

post.description: Canonical existing writer; exact two-field JSON object, maximum 8192 bytes. No automatic retry after uncertain delivery. Same-origin Laravel CSRF checks remain authoritative.
